notes.title: 30K Wishlists, Price, Expected Playtime, Demo Reward
notes.content: [p]Hey, thank you for 30K wishlists![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468495/810304d13ccb82bd22df37b45c5fb18424f23e59.gif"][/img][/p][p]We've updated all screenshots, so check them out if you are interested in Skill Tree, new Bosses, etc.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, let's answer the often asked questions: price, content, and demo progress.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468495/e32690151b390e6d4a3f15f431f22178e7d55860.gif"][/img][/p][h2]**PRICE**[/h2][p]at -10% for the first 14 days:[/p][p]$8.99 | 8.77€ | 35.99zł | £7.65[/p][p]and standard Steam price conversion for other currencies[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468495/e32690151b390e6d4a3f15f431f22178e7d55860.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468495/e32690151b390e6d4a3f15f431f22178e7d55860.gif"][/img][/p][h2]**CONTENT**[/h2][p]How much content is there? It is difficult to estimate playtime in a game that can be played actively or may be left in the background for hours. Build types, hard/soft prestiges done, completed challenges - each can heavily affect the time.[/p][p]Our estimates are:[/p][p]~3 days to beat the main Bosses[/p][p]~1-2 weeks to get all achievements[/p][p]??? to max everything, get all pets and complete optional content[/p][p]After beating all the Bosses, it's not over. You can continue playing, and it's worth doing so, as each Boss drops unique items, and duplicates are used to reveal additional effects. It'll be possible to do 100% in the game, such as beating all bosses, collecting all items, getting max levels. There'll be some end-game activities, like Steam leaderboards in the Arena.[/p][p]If you want to know details, SPOILERS: Content of the full game is ||13+|| Bosses, ||15+|| structures, ||27+|| equipment items (each with multiple upgrades), ||14|| Pets, ||Weather|| system, numerous variants of Meteors, Skill Tree.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468495/e32690151b390e6d4a3f15f431f22178e7d55860.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468495/e32690151b390e6d4a3f15f431f22178e7d55860.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468495/e32690151b390e6d4a3f15f431f22178e7d55860.gif"][/img][/p][h2]**DEMO REWARD & PROGRESS**[/h2][p]If you've managed to beat Crystal Golem in the demo and kept the save, you'll receive a special pet to make sure your comeback is rock solid! The pet will be tough to get in-game otherwise.[/p][p]You will keep your items from the demo (equipment, materials, keys), but gold and town upgrades do not carry over. You'll be able to start completely fresh if you prefer, and still keep the pet.[/p][p][/p][p]Release is in just 10 days![/p]

notes.title: IDLE BOSS RUSH GOES LIVE SEPT 29TH
notes.content: [p]You might have thought, 'man, these lazy devs don't post any updates, surely they took a long vacation.' In reality, we were so locked in on the production that we neglected this part. [/p][p]Now that Q3 is almost over, it's time to finally reveal the release date:[/p][p][/p][p][b]IDLE BOSS RUSH is coming to Steam on SEPTEMBER 29.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468495/9c5d2c1a85f2b61030572c6c6014da17de360c06.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We have some awesome new content to show you, including (heavily requested on [url="https://discord.gg/vg4nhPYrSK"]Discord[/url]) pets. Updated screenshots and more info are coming soon - stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Ada & Mike[/p]

notes.title: Play the Demo of IDLE BOSS RUSH on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Over the past few weeks, we’ve been focused on improving the IDLE BOSS RUSH demo, based on feedback from players like you. Thanks so much to everyone who took the time to share their thoughts - it’s been a huge help![/p][p]If you’d like to try the demo, now’s a great time. We have a challenge for you:[/p][olist][*][p]Fight through all the bosses![/p][/*][*][p]Collect all the items![/p][/*][*][p]Unlock all 3 achievements![/p][/*][/olist][p]If that’s not enough, test yourself in the Arena, and join our [url="https://discord.gg/FSqZVhbBnG"]Discord [/url]to share your high score. Feel free to share your feedback as well.[/p][p]We’ve also updated the trailer, which is now available to watch on the Steam page and [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_nKSWFUJD98"]YouTube[/url].[/p][p][/p]
